notes.title: Visibility Re-Update: Streamer Mode Introduced + New/Alt Scenes
notes.content:
Hey all, Shald here. So here's the deal: Steam allows you to submit your game for additional rounds of advertising and marketing visibility, but [b]only[/b] within 30 days of a recent major update. Guess what we didn't know about when we first started developing this game? :D That's right, we didn't know ANY of that!

So, yes. This announcement is a duplicate of an older announcement so we can properly categorize Women of Xal's 1.5 update as a "Major Update" and therefore get the game on the front page of Steam for a few weeks. :') Rest assured that we're not going to be re-hashing old content forever; now that we know about the additional visibility rounds, we'll definitely use them properly going forward. 

As for what we still have planned for this game, here's a quick list: 
- Continue the story in WoX 2
- Steam Achievements

Here are the original 1.5 patch notes from March 24, 2022.

=================================================

Some of ya'll went deep to find those visual glitches, and we've got you! Visual glitches have been taken out, and a slew of sneaky typos have been nixed. Because of how easy this was, we were able to focus on new features!

[list]
[*] [b]Streamer Mode[/b]! On every run except True Ending, you can skip the first 3 or so hours to get to the more general audience appropriate parts of the plot, with the slow burn being summed up in cheeky little sentences. You should be able to start character routes sooner than later if you go with Streamer Mode. If you decide to choose "Explorer Mode" for the slow burn and learn more about the world and its characters, the game proceeds as normal.

[*] [b]New OC for Most of You[/b]! A fan's character has entered the world of Xal! You'll see her right at the very start of the game. We hope you enjoy Piaxa. She's adorable. Thank you for your support!

[*] [b]Alt dialogue for a few scenes Xanamae[/b]. No matter the mode, had her dialogue shortened even more. This time only partly because of how wordy she is! This time, it's because Hilde covers her lore drop.

[*] [b]Hilde Covers Humans Lying[/b]. You're potentially introduced to Furnell early as Hilde's first mandatory lecture now focuses on the ability to lie, and not organs or anything else. Consequently, the lecture is far shorter.
[/list]

I hope you all keep enjoying the game! Please don't forget to leave a review~! <3
-John

notes.title: True Ending Patch Notes (January 22nd 2023)
notes.content: Some folks couldn't get ruthless points on their runs. I have fixed it and released the bugs to the sky above.

notes.title: Small Batch of Bugs Chucked Outside to Live... Elsewhere + Same Page Lore Fixes
notes.content:
And by same page, I mean the dev build was different from public build where we thought certain significant lore details were in every timeline. It wasn't!

Bugs like spelling mistakes, grammar derps, and some inconsequential structuring fixed up. Lastly, Steam's build now has one unified build between PC and Mac, so there should be less steps to get them both working for future updates.

notes.title: Women of Xal 1.3 Update: Nerfs and Buffs! Yes in a VN
notes.content:
Some quality of life updates, as well as some nerfs and buffs!

[list]
[*] A slew of obscure and not so obscure typos have been taken care of.
[*] Some narrative clarifications to reduce vagueness in some instances.
[*] You now have to complete the game before you fall asleep in front of someone.
[*] Furnell's route is now easier to unlock.
[*] Culiver is no longer a magical girl on his route.
[*] We celebrate not having to update the game for well over a week. \o/
[*] Sleep resumes.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.29 is Live! [Hotfix]
notes.content: More annoying bugs have been taken care of. Comes out, we couldn't predict every single combination a player could undergo!

notes.title: Bug Fixes And A Chance To Vote On Your Favorite Character!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://plottwiststudios.squarespace.com/config/?frameUrl=%2Fawards2021]VOTING TAKES PLACE HERE. LIVE UNTIL NOVEMBER 28th!
[/url][/h1]

Ya'll found some truly [b]obscure [/b]bugs, but we squashed every last one of them, and the experience is now more polished for it. Just little tiny things like names not being labeled, or misspellings.

Additionally, you can now go into the Extras > About portion of the game and vote for your favorite character in this year's People's Choice Awards! Alternatively, you can click the giant link above and it'll take you to the same place! There, you can vote in a wide variety of categories for best, worst, most charismatic, ect!

notes.title: Women of Xal Launch!
notes.content:
Women of Xal, 4 years later. It's finally released. And now, for the update  that separates Early Access from the full version!

Release Notes: 

[list]
[*] The game's front page now better fits the kind of vibe Women of Xal offers.
[*] Sound Effects added
[*] Over 20 new tracks
[*] Some events have new/changed music
[*] Several new events and activities
[*] A skip animation feature
[*] New screens for loading the game
[*] New animations
[*] Nerfed Reduced the requirement for unlocking certain routes
[*] True Ending has changed credits/video
[*] We let go of some lore secrets that we held deep in our hearts
[*] ^ More clues about the lore and the story/characters have also been released
[*] Added Calendar UI.
[*] Added Axay and Merixa's Arcs. All arcs are now available in-game.
[*] Added Date Days near the end of the game.
[*] Finished CG Gallery.
[*] Added Character Descriptions to the Character Galleries
[*] Finished Libraries.
[*] Added at least 1 alt outfit for everyone. Most alt outfits are now in the game, or at least viewable after completing a character's arc.
[*] 
[*] Fixed typos.
[*] Fixed a tense (past/present) issue in the first few lines of the game.
[*] 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused character arcs to still be clickable after their completion.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a failsafe to trigger after certain character arcs due to the day tag not being properly represented in-game.
[*] 
[*] Removed one day of Culiver's Arc where nothing in particular happened, which was originally just padding.
[*] Removed multiple relic variables that did nothing anymore
[*] Improved some backend coding to make the game load faster.
[*] Set up the build so patches can happen quicker and easier.
[*] Walkthrough isn't here, because we're opting to nap. We want to nap. See you in Napville.
[/list]

Happy playing, and thank you for sticking with us for so long! <3
-John

notes.title: Patch 2.51
notes.content:
Players and ourselves caught some interesting errors. We killed the errors.

-Velvet's route is actually playable now, like it was supposed to be in 2.5
-Artimis' route was accidentally deleted in 2.5. It's back in now.
-New CG added for True Ending.
-Slight video editing update
-New music for True Ending
-Fixed minor dialogue annoyances, sprite displacements, and an eternal loop.
-Slightly reduced the size of the game, with more optimization coming in future updates.
